scope: Primary-source verification of the first user-supplied additional image-model candidate list; no weight download, benchmark, GPU submission or fine-tuning performed.

MobileCLIP2-S3.role: image-text aligned encoder; compare with the current fixed class prompts
MobileCLIP2-S3.integration_note: Verify the OpenCLIP/MobileCLIP2 integration and use official inference reparameterization; compatibility with the current pinned OpenCLIP 3.3.0 environment has not been tested.

MobileCLIP2-S4.role: image-text aligned encoder; compare with the current fixed class prompts
MobileCLIP2-S4.integration_note: Verify the OpenCLIP/MobileCLIP2 integration and use official inference reparameterization; compatibility with the current pinned OpenCLIP 3.3.0 environment has not been tested.

MobileCLIP2-B.role: image-text aligned encoder; compare with the current fixed class prompts

PE-Core-S16-384.role: image-text aligned encoder; compare with the current fixed class prompts

DINOv3-S16.role: image feature encoder; requires a fitted classifier or labeled-reference retrieval for classification
DINOv3-S16.license: DINOv3-specific license; Hub access gate applies
DINOv3-S16.comparison_note: The distilled small model has no text encoder for the current fixed class-prompt benchmark. Official dino.txt uses the large ViT-L/16 model, a different candidate.

EUPE-ViT-S.role: released image feature backbone; paired text checkpoint and same-protocol prompt inference unverified
EUPE-ViT-S.comparison_note: Paper reports ImageNet zero-shot accuracy; released model card documents image class/patch features. The paired text tower and reproducible prompt inference path have not been verified.

ppocr_v6_training_assets.training_code_and_configs: Public PaddleOCR main has detection and recognition configurations for Tiny, Small and Medium.
ppocr_v6_training_assets.non_onnx_weights: Public Paddle inference weights and safetensors repositories exist, in addition to ONNX exports.
ppocr_v6_training_assets.raw_resumable_training_checkpoint: Not verified. The inspected native files are inference.pdiparams/inference.json/inference.yml; inspected training config pretrained_model/checkpoint fields are empty.
ppocr_v6_training_assets.fine_tuning_prerequisite: Verify loading or conversion of the supplied inference weights into the actual trainable recognition model; non-ONNX format alone does not establish direct trainability.
ppocr_v6_training_assets.large_variant: Paper states a future release plan; no Large model in the inspected official collection. This is not a global claim of nonexistence.

ocr_context.note: 85.98 percent belongs to common_old plus contrast preprocessing, not PP-OCRv6. Fine-tuning PP-OCRv6 on alphanumeric images starts from its own measured baseline.

limitations: Model-file SHA-256 values come from official Hub LFS metadata; downloaded weight bytes have not been verified because no weights were downloaded.
Model checkpoints include image and text components where applicable; file sizes are not deployed image-encoder sizes or runtime memory measurements.
Larger models have not been shown to improve this task; all candidate accuracies and timings remain unmeasured.
Only previous image/board aggregate reports are present in this workspace; the exact earlier input manifest and image files must be recovered or explicitly reconstructed before a new comparison.
DINOv3 or EUPE with a fitted head must use a declared training/validation/test split and cannot be reported as the same untrained zero-shot comparison.
